_comment: cloud-ci-supply-chain-audit gate policy (owned RustSec advisory scan; replaces the reverted #974 shell cargo-audit/deny). R1 pack-shaped DATA: lockfile_corpus is the authoritative, reviewed set of Cargo-owned lockfiles, pairing each repo-relative Cargo.toml build root with its sibling Cargo.lock. The collector reads only these declared files and the vendored content-addressed RustSec mirror; it never recursively walks mutable filesystem state. Normalized relative paths, sibling ownership, regular-file type, and no-symlink containment are validated fail-closed. min_lockfiles prevents silent corpus shrink. The legacy single lockfile_path shape remains engine-compatible for adopters. Security advisories block as SCA-VULN; unmaintained advisories block as SCA-UNMAINTAINED (gated by unmaintained_policy=all). Mirror content_hash/count/min_advisories fail closed. No shell, network, or clock.

ignore.reason: async-std is unmaintained; no maintained drop-in is wired yet. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.
ignore.pull_chain: transitive dependency in the workspace graph (async-std 1.13.2 in Cargo.lock)

ignore.reason: paste is unmaintained; it is a widely-used proc-macro shim with no maintained drop-in replacement. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.
proc-macro-error2 is unmaintained; pulled transitively by derive macros with no maintained drop-in yet. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking: matches every lockfile_corpus entry against the committed advisory mirror. Any new affected security advisory or unmaintained crate in the root, kernel, cloud-kernel, or detached host-test lockfile blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; repo-specific workspace/lockfile pairs, min_lockfiles, mirror_dir, and ignores are DATA here. Legacy adopters using one lockfile_path remain supported.
product_contract.hermetic: Pure Rust predicate: serde_json + toml + semver only (no rustsec/git2/libgit2, shell, network, clock, or recursive filesystem discovery). Declared paths are normalized repo-relative sibling pairs; symlinks, missing files, type errors, malformed manifests, and policy underflow fail closed. The collected JSON schema remains locked/name/version + advisories + manifest.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: Upgrade the affected crate to a patched version, or — for an unmaintained dep with no maintained drop-in — add a time-boxed ignore[] entry with reason/pull_chain/remove_by.
